targets.proof_safe: exact match: prediction.proof_safe_verdict == key.proof_safe (artifact field as recorded by frozen driver mapping)

runtime_failure_treatment.rule: conservative default per spec section 8 (certification-metrics.md has no explicit runtime-failure override)
runtime_failure_treatment.exact_accuracy_metrics: incorrect on semantic, proof_safe, and product
runtime_failure_treatment.auto_proof_metrics: not counted as accepted proof; excluded from proof-validity denominators
runtime_failure_treatment.coverage: recorded separately as RUNTIME_FAILURE / no valid decision

prediction_verdict_mapping: as already applied by frozen Phase-1 driver: PARTIAL->PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, INSUFFICIENT->INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; no re-mapping in Phase 2

review_required_handling.semantic: predicted final semantic verdict REVIEW_REQUIRED is scored as its own predicted class and is incorrect unless key semantic_truth equals it (never true for this key)
review_required_handling.proof_safe: predicted proof_safe uses the recorded artifact field; non-accepted routes map to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE per frozen driver
review_required_handling.product: REVIEW_REQUIRED is a scored product class; correct iff key product_expected_action is REVIEW_REQUIRED

abstention_handling.rule: ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT correct iff key product_expected_action is ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT
abstention_handling.subgroup: cases with key semantic_truth == INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (N=7 core) form the genuine-insufficiency subgroup, flagged LOW_N_EXPLORATORY, included in overall score

validity_rederivation.deterministic_auto_routes: re-run frozen polarity_engine_v02.judge_claim + auto_gate on the case inputs; proof valid iff outputs equal the recorded proof_object.engine and gate_reason is None
validity_rederivation.reviewer_accepted_routes: re-derive with frozen reviewer.fusion(): rebuild the evidence packet with frozen build_packet from recorded inputs, re-run fusion with the recorded reviewer output and classify_threshold; valid iff route == 'accepted'
validity_rederivation.no_model_calls: all re-derivation is deterministic; reviewer is never re-queried

proof_validity_handling.hallucinated_proof: accepted route whose cited span ids are absent from the rebuilt packet or whose output fails frozen fidelity checks

auto_decision_precision.primary_metric_proof_based: auto decisions are product_action in {AUTO_SUPPORTED, AUTO_CONTRADICTED}; correct iff key proof_safe equals the corresponding verdict (SUPPORTED for AUTO_SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED for AUTO_CONTRADICTED) per evaluation contract 'auto is right iff the verdict matches proof_safe'

compound_aggregation: atom-level accuracy computed from key.atom_labels vs engine atom_results where atom counts allow alignment; final compound verdict scored by the same exact-match rule as all semantic cases
dispute_handling: all key entries annotation_status CONFIRMED with no remaining disputes per blind-manifest; any apparent label error is flagged POTENTIAL_BLIND_LABEL_ERROR after official-score freeze and never changes the official score
rounding: percentages rounded to 1 decimal place for reporting; pass/fail computed on unrounded ratios

subgroup_membership.safety: claim matches SAFETY_RE from frozen reviewer.py (selvmord|selvskad|livsfare|akutt fare|vold|trud|truet|fare for livet)
subgroup_membership.legal: claim matches LEGAL_RE from frozen reviewer.py (rett|plikt|lovhjemmel|samtykke|klage)
subgroup_membership.numeric: claim matches NUMERIC_RE from frozen reviewer.py (digit|kr|kroner|prosent|prosentpoeng)
subgroup_membership.temporal: claim contains year 19xx/20xx or date/deadline/duration keywords (aar|ar$|maaned|uke|dager|frist|dato|gjelder fra|til og med)
subgroup_membership.condition_exception: claim contains hvis|dersom|unntak|sa lenge|med mindre|bortsett fra|gjelder ikke
subgroup_membership.note: keyword heuristics re-derived from documented construction method; actual counts reported as computed, construction deltas documented as caveat

hard_gates: unsafe auto-decision rate on critical cases == 0
pass_fail_logic.verdict: RC1_CERTIFIED iff all hard gates and thresholds pass; RC1_NOT_CERTIFIED if any fails; CERTIFICATION_INVALID only for integrity/blindness compromise
